layer1_source_intent: Merge the two row_phase passes of the C256 QKV projection into one M-batched pass: one subgroup holds m0a=(sg%4)*8 and m0b=m0a+32 simultaneously and loads each weight tile once, feeding two independent MMA accumulators. Per SG: weight tiles 192 -> 96, A tiles 64 -> 64, DPAS 192 -> 192, live QK accumulators 4 -> 8, V 2 -> 4.
